description: Get a price correlation matrix for crypto and supported TradFi assets over a specified calendar period. Useful for portfolio analysis and diversification.

ids.description: Comma-separated asset ids: CoinGecko ids for crypto (e.g. bitcoin) and short ids for TradFi (e.g. sp500, gold). Maximum 10. If omitted, returns the default set. Ids no source recognises are listed in an optional `unresolved` array (partial success); a selection none of whose ids is recognised returns 404 resource_not_found naming them.

name: get_correlation_matrix

unresolved.description: Requested ids no source recognises (no TradFi config, coin metadata, CoinGecko row or stored returns). Present only when non-empty; each still gets a row and column, with null correlations.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Correlation matrix
